bitcrush.change: User requested more bitcrushing after the 9-bit/24 kHz/.86 derivative. Local 6-bit signed quantization, 18 kHz independent hold clock and .98 crushed mix; preserve selected human timing/pitch and shared ear-room profiles.

reverb.method: Synthesized decaying-noise/early-reflection IR, deterministically authored. Not measured; not a recording of this room. Mono fold of normalized stereo IR before convolution; one physical HRTF emitter at runtime. Wet-only response gain is calibrated after normalization to -18 dB active-window RMS relative to dry; 0.14 send, IR shape and dry level stay fixed.
reverb.normalization: ConvolverNode RMS calibration (.00125 * 44100 / sampleRate / max(.000125, IR_RMS)), followed by separately stated wet response gain.

reverb.activeWindowMethod: 20 ms dry-RMS blocks within 24 dB of strongest block; first through last qualifying block
